coimbatore.drainage: Moderately well-drained in red tracts; slow drainage in deep black soils
coimbatore.calcium_carbonate_content: Calcareous nodules present in subsoil horizons
coimbatore.recommendations: Add well-decomposed Farm Yard Manure (FYM) @ 12.5 t/ha to enhance organic carbon and soil structure. Apply phosphobacteria to mobilize fixed phosphorus in alkaline zones.
coimbatore.source: ICAR-NBSS&LUP Soil Resource Mapping & Tamil Nadu Soil Health Card Portal

tiruppur.dominant_soil_type: Red Gravelly Sandy Loam & Shallow Black Soil
tiruppur.drainage: Well-drained to somewhat excessively drained in gravelly areas
tiruppur.recommendations: Adopt green manuring with sunn hemp (Crotalaria juncea) or daincha before main season. Maintain soil mulching to conserve moisture.
tiruppur.source: TNAU Department of Soil Science and Agricultural Chemistry

salem.dominant_soil_type: Red Sandy Loam to Lateritic Loam
salem.recommendations: Suitable for tapioca, tomato, chillies, and mango. Apply balanced NPK with micronutrient zinc sulphate @ 25 kg/ha.

thanjavur.drainage: Poor to moderately slow drainage; water-retentive
thanjavur.recommendations: Prime paddy delta zone. Ensure surface drainage channels to prevent waterlogging during monsoon. Apply biofertilizer Azospirillum for paddy.
thanjavur.source: ICAR-NRRI & Tamil Nadu Agricultural University Delta Research Station

madurai.dominant_soil_type: Red Sandy Clay & Deep Black Soils
madurai.calcium_carbonate_content: Calcareous nodules common in deep black belts
madurai.recommendations: Ideal for banana, jasmine, cotton, and pulses. Apply gypsum @ 500 kg/ha in high sodium pockets if soil test shows sodicity.

tiruchirappalli.dominant_soil_type: Riverine Alluvial Loam & Red Sandy Clay
tiruchirappalli.recommendations: Highly productive for banana (NRCB belt) and paddy. Split potassium application is recommended to maintain sustained nutrient uptake.

guntur.dominant_soil_type: Deep Black Cotton Soils (Vertisols) & Coastal Alluvium
guntur.drainage: Slow drainage; high swelling and shrinkage properties
guntur.calcium_carbonate_content: Free lime and kankar nodules common
guntur.recommendations: World-famous chilli and cotton tract. Avoid over-irrigation to prevent wilt and root rot. Apply organic amendments to reduce soil compaction.
guntur.source: Acharya N.G. Ranga Agricultural University (ANGRAU) & Soil Health Card AP

pune.dominant_soil_type: Medium to Deep Black Basaltic Soil (Vertic Inceptisols)
pune.recommendations: Excellent for tomato, onion, sugarcane, and pomegranate. Ensure broad bed and furrow (BBF) layout to avoid waterlogging during heavy monsoon spells.

shimoga.dominant_soil_type: Red Lateritic Soil to Clayey Loam (Oxisols/Ultisols)
shimoga.available_phosphorus: Low (Phosphorus fixation high due to iron/aluminum oxides)
shimoga.texture: Sandy Clay Loam to Lateritic Gravelly Loam
shimoga.recommendations: Apply agricultural lime or dolomite @ 1.5 - 2.0 t/ha every 3-4 years to correct soil acidity. Use rock phosphate or SSP with mycorrhiza to boost phosphorus availability.
shimoga.source: University of Agricultural and Horticultural Sciences (UAHS), Shivamogga

karnal.texture: Fine Sandy Loam to Silt Loam
karnal.recommendations: Intensive Rice-Wheat / Potato belt. Incline towards laser land leveling and incorporation of crop residues with microbial decomposers to build up depleted organic matter.
karnal.source: ICAR - Central Soil Salinity Research Institute (CSSRI), Karnal

default_fallback.recommendations: Adopt balanced NPK 4:2:1 ratio supplemented with organic compost @ 10 t/ha. Test soil samples at nearest district Soil Testing Laboratory (KVK) for farm-specific prescriptions.
default_fallback.source: ICAR All India Coordinated Research Project on Soil Test Crop Response (AICRP-STCR)
